logo.label: Footer logo
logo.doc: The lockup across the foot of every page. It is artwork, not type — the words behind it exist only as the name a screen reader reads out.

logo_width.label: Footer logo width
logo_width.doc: How wide it is, in pixels. It never grows past the space available, so a large number means “as big as it fits” on a phone.

logo_href.label: Footer logo links to
logo_href.doc: Where clicking it goes. Leave empty and it is not a link at all.

pad_top.label: Space above
pad_top.doc: The breathing room between the last section and the footer, in pixels.

pad_bottom.label: Space below
pad_bottom.doc: The room under the lockup before the page ends.

align.label: Alignment
align.doc: Where the lockup and the social icon sit.

show_social.label: Social icon
show_social.doc: The small icon at the foot. It uses the links saved on Brand info, so hiding it here leaves those alone.

social_size.label: Social icon size
social_size.doc: How big that icon is, in pixels.

legal.label: Small print
legal.doc: The copyright line at the foot of every page. Type {year} anywhere in it and the current year is filled in automatically — you never have to come back in January. Leave empty for no small print at all.
legal.default: © {year} Blacktop Restaurant Group. All rights reserved.

legal_align.label: Small print sits
legal_align.doc: Which corner the copyright line and the legal links sit in, independently of how the rest of the footer is aligned.

links.label: Legal links
links.doc:
ONE LINK PER LINE, written as the words you want, then a vertical bar, then the page path. For example:

Privacy Policy|/privacy-policy/
Cookie Policy|/cookie-policy/

You can also just paste a path on its own — /privacy-policy/ — and the words are made from it. A full web address works too, for anything off this site.
